top_signals.title: Alphabet Is Paying Up for Euro Bonds in Test of AI Appetite
top_signals.summary: Alphabet Inc. is raising funds in the euro bond market for the second time this year, offering considerably higher yields than in its sale in May after concerns over the pace of AI spending drove a credit-market selloff.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
